acceptance: A UAT ai_primitives cell on a runner without a provider no longer produces a validator error.
A run where every query is skipped is not reported as passed.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage1-duckdb: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells.

Closed 2026-11-11 against current evidence: PR #3747: execution.py raises "executed no queries" for standard/power runs with no results (test_base_adapter.py:565), and UAT prunes ai_primitives on platforms without AI functions with a recorded reason (compatibility.py). Trunk UAT 42718296767 (52615914) shows ai_primitives pruned on DuckDB/SQLite/Spark/QuestDB; no validator errors; scheduled 42789483182 (ce39d768) green.
description: DuckDB ai_primitives at SF 0.01, 0.1 and 1 passed in release UAT but every result failed validation with 'summary.queries.total must be greater than 0 for a public result' (benchbox/validation/bundle.py:1316). With no model provider on the runner every query is skipped, yet the run exits 0 and writes a result. Decide the contract: the run should fail or be classified as skipped when no query can execute, or UAT should prune ai_primitives on runners without a provider.
